L21:   *   *   *   *   *   *   *   * ## TITANIUM DIOXIDE
L22: grades PRETIOX^{®} have optimal average particle size and very narrow particle size distribution, high tinting strength, neutral or slightly blue undertone. High reflectance in the wavelength range of visible light and their high light-scattering power in common paint media are another important features. The low difference in a range of optical parameters brings a stable colour shade and enables application in different tinting system especially in case of use of micronized rutile grades.
L23: Effective surface treatment minimises flocculation in a number of paint systems and allows easy processing during application with good following stability in paint systems.
L24: Titanium dioxide PRETIOX^{®}CG is a very effective inorganic photocatalyst for removing some organic and inorganic pollutants (above all NO_{X}). When illuminated with UV light (below 380 nm), electron-hole pairs are generated in valence and conduction bands. The oxidative reaction in the presence of molecules of water or oxygen results in creating surface radicals. They attack molecules of pollutants and cause their degradation.
L25: PRETIOX^{®}CG types are suitable for any photocatalytic application from air pollution treatment, organic substances decomposition, photocatalytic products or surfaces to cleaning troublesome water organic pollution.
